label: Privacy Notice
title: Privacy Notice.
summary: How Institute of Directors-Ghana handles personal information across our website and online services.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Who this notice covers

fields.label: Text
fields.value: This Privacy Notice explains how the Institute of Directors-Ghana (IoD-Gh, we, us or our) handles personal information collected through iodghana.org, its member and CMS services, and the IoD-Gh Examination Portal. It applies when you browse the site, contact us, apply for membership, use an account, register interest in a programme or sit an examination.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Please read this notice together with any service-specific information shown when you provide your details. If another notice applies to a particular programme or service, that notice will explain any additional handling of your information.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Information we collect

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We collect the information you choose to give us, such as your name, email address, telephone number, organisation, professional role, membership details, enquiry messages and information included in a membership application.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: For a membership application, your CV is sent as an email attachment directly to authorised IoD-Gh membership staff for assessment. The website does not retain the uploaded CV after that delivery.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: When you use an account or the Examination Portal, we collect the information needed to provide that service. This can include account and sign-in details, your name and email address, examination access and session records, answers, submitted work, results and relevant security logs.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why we use information

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We use personal information to respond to enquiries, assess and administer membership applications, provide member, programme and examination services, send the updates or results you ask us to send, and communicate with you about your relationship with IoD-Gh.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We also use information to protect our services, prevent misuse, maintain records, improve the website and meet legal, regulatory and governance responsibilities. Membership decisions are made by authorised IoD-Gh staff. Examination results are calculated from answers submitted in the portal and are available for authorised staff review.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Cookies and site analytics

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We use essential cookies only where they are needed to keep sign-in, security and examination sessions working. These cookies are not used for advertising or cross-site tracking. You can manage cookies through your browser, but blocking essential cookies may prevent some secure services from working properly.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: The public website uses first-party, cookie-free analytics to understand aggregate visits and improve our pages. It records the page viewed, referral host and broad device type. A one-way visitor marker is rotated daily for aggregate counts; we do not store raw IP addresses or a persistent analytics identifier.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Who receives information

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Access is limited to authorised IoD-Gh staff and trusted service providers that help us operate the website, hosting, email delivery, security and related services. They may process personal information only as needed to provide services to us and in line with appropriate instructions.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We may also share information when required by law, to protect the rights, safety or security of IoD-Gh and others, or as part of a lawful organisational process. Where information is processed outside Ghana, we will take reasonable steps to ensure that it is handled with appropriate safeguards.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: How long we keep it

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected. This includes membership administration, examination records, programme delivery, security, record-keeping and any legal or regulatory obligations.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Retention periods vary according to the type of information and the service involved. When information is no longer needed, we will securely delete it or make it anonymous where appropriate.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Your choices and rights

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Subject to applicable law, you may ask about the personal information we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate information, object to certain processing, ask for restriction or deletion in appropriate circumstances, or withdraw consent where our use of information depends on consent.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: To make a request, please contact us using the details below. We may need to confirm your identity before responding. You may also raise a concern with Ghana’s Data Protection Commission if you believe your privacy rights have been affected.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Keeping information secure

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We use reasonable organisational and technical measures designed to protect personal information from unauthorised access, loss, misuse or alteration. No online service can be completely risk-free, so please protect your account credentials and do not share examination access codes or other confidential information.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Contact and updates

fields.label: Text
fields.value: For a privacy request or question, contact IoD-Gh at info@iodghana.org. We may update this notice when our services or legal obligations change. The latest version will always be published on this page with its revision date.

fields.label: Revision date
fields.value: Last updated: 11 October 2026

label: Terms of Use
title: Terms of Use.
summary: The conditions for using the IoD-Gh website, member services and Examination Portal.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Accepting these terms

fields.label: Text
fields.value: These Terms of Use govern your use of the Institute of Directors-Ghana (IoD-Gh) website and its online services. By accessing or using them, you agree to these Terms and to use the services lawfully and responsibly.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: If you use a service on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you have authority to do so. Additional terms, notices, eligibility criteria or fees may apply to a membership, programme or examination. Where they do, they form part of the relevant arrangement.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Using the website responsibly

fields.label: Text
fields.value: You must not interfere with the security, availability or normal operation of the website, attempt to gain unauthorised access to an account or restricted system, introduce malicious code, scrape restricted content, or use the service to submit unlawful, misleading or harmful material.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We may take reasonable steps to protect the website and its users, including limiting access, removing material or suspending a service where we reasonably believe these Terms have been breached or there is a security risk.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Accounts and access

fields.label: Text
fields.value: You are responsible for keeping your account details, passwords and other access information confidential. You must tell us promptly if you believe your account has been accessed without permission or any credentials have been lost, disclosed or compromised.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We may suspend, reset or protect access where this is reasonably necessary to keep an account, a member, an applicant, an examination candidate or the wider service secure.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Membership and programmes

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Submitting an application or expression of interest does not itself create membership, confirm programme enrolment or guarantee eligibility. Membership applications are assessed by the appropriate IoD-Gh committee, and any decision will be communicated through the relevant process.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Programme information, dates, fees, availability and requirements may change. We will make reasonable efforts to keep published information current, but a separate programme communication may contain the final details for a particular event or course.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Examination Portal

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Examination access is assigned by authorised administrators. Access codes are personal to the eligible cohort and must not be shared. Candidates must enter their own name and email address, provide accurate information and complete assessments independently unless the examination instructions expressly allow otherwise.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We may invalidate, pause or review an examination attempt where there is a reasonable concern about eligibility, identity, integrity, misuse or a technical or security issue. Results are calculated from submitted answers and may be reviewed by authorised IoD-Gh staff before they are treated as final.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Content and intellectual property

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Unless stated otherwise, the website’s content, branding, publications, examination materials and design are owned by or licensed to IoD-Gh. You may view or download material made available for personal, professional and non-commercial use, but may not reproduce, modify, distribute or commercially exploit it without permission.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Materials you submit remain yours. By submitting them, you give IoD-Gh permission to use them only as necessary to provide, assess or administer the requested service and to meet related record-keeping obligations.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Availability and external links

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We aim to keep the website accurate, secure and available, but content, services and links may change or be temporarily unavailable. We may correct errors, update content, maintain systems or withdraw a feature when reasonably needed.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Links to external websites are provided for convenience. IoD-Gh does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content, availability, security or privacy practices.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Disclaimers and liability

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Website content is provided for general information. Unless we explicitly agree otherwise in writing, it is not professional, legal, financial or other advice and should not be relied on as a substitute for advice tailored to your circumstances.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: To the extent permitted by applicable law, IoD-Gh is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of, or inability to use, this website. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Privacy, law and changes

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Our handling of personal information is explained in our Privacy Notice. These Terms are governed by the laws of Ghana. Any dispute will be addressed in accordance with applicable Ghanaian law, subject to any mandatory rights you may have.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We may update these Terms from time to time by publishing a revised version on this page. Continuing to use the website after an update means you accept the updated Terms.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Contact us

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Questions about these Terms can be sent to info@iodghana.org.
